text: A brand-new claim just sits with whoever created it -- no region, no connection to either service queue. Devon fixes that with a Flow.
Warranty_Claim_Auto_Routing fires the instant a claim is created, looks up the related Account, and reads its region.
It sets Region__c on the claim and reassigns the owner to West_Service_Queue or East_Service_Queue -- before the record even finishes saving.
Devon and the team test it against real West and East accounts, plus a missing-data edge case, and it routes correctly every time.
Next: building the reports and dashboard Service leadership needs to see how the warranty program is actually running.
